analysis.reasonEn: 3 consecutive sessions of wait-and-see. RSI entered oversold territory, MACD histogram shows improvement but trend formation is weak. Higher Low pattern confirmed with 5-day low $0.87 and 20-day low $0.87. Volume surge of 1.74x suggests potential for buying interest, but price remains below SMA200 (-26.94%) and weekly RSI at 33.9 indicates continued weakness. Considering ATR volatility of 6%, a buy entry level with a 1.3x stop loss ($0.85) and 2.6x target ($1.04) is not yet confirmed.
